# RepoCortex

> RepoCortex is an open-source MCP server and CLI (`cortex`, alias `repocortex`) that indexes a code repository into a graph of symbols, call edges, HTTP routes, SQL tables, configuration keys and tests, and serves it to AI coding agents over the Model Context Protocol. It runs locally from one static Go binary and stores the graph in SQLite at `.cortex/index.db`. Apache-2.0.

An AI agent asks RepoCortex a question instead of searching: what a task touches, who calls a function, what a change can break (blast radius) or which tests reach it. Every edge in an answer is marked with how it was found, and every answer states what the index could not see.

## Facts
- Command: `cortex`; alias `repocortex`. Requires Go 1.26+ to build from source; no CGO.
- Protocol: MCP over stdio. Clients configured by `cortex install --rules`: Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Antigravity. Any stdio MCP client works.
- Confidence tiers: `exact` (proven by a compiler index, SCIP), `high` (syntax tree with imports; 94.2–100% precise per language in measurements), `medium` (inferred; under 50%), `low` (loose name match; hidden by default). Details: docs/accuracy.md.
- Languages: 206 tree-sitter grammars. Typed (3): Go, Java, TypeScript. Resolved (11): C, C#, C++, JavaScript, Kotlin, PHP, Python, Ruby, Rust, Scala, TSX. Parsed (192): definitions and search only.
- Privacy: no network requests while indexing or serving, no telemetry. The opt-in `cortex indexers install` is the only command that downloads anything.
- MCP profiles: `minimal` (default) exposes 7 tools; `standard` and `full` expose all 18.

## MCP tools (18)
- minimal (default): get_task_context, get_project_overview, search_code, find_symbol, get_symbol, find_references, find_callers
- standard / full add: find_tests, impact_analysis, resolution_coverage, plan_rename, find_api_endpoints, find_db_access, get_config_key, get_file_outline, minimize_diff, plan_change, detect_blindspots

## Quickstart
```
go install github.com/satyendrakumarsingh/repocortex/cmd/cortex@latest
cd your-project
cortex init && cortex index && cortex resolve
cortex install --rules
```

## Key CLI commands
- `cortex context "<task>"`: the files, symbols, callers and tests a task needs
- `cortex callers <symbol>` / `cortex callees <symbol>`: call edges with confidence
- `cortex impact --base <rev> --head <rev>`: blast radius of a commit range
- `cortex rename <old> <new>`: rename that edits only sites it can defend
- `cortex api` / `cortex db` / `cortex config` / `cortex events`: routes, tables, settings, queues
- `cortex arch --fail-on high` / `cortex missed --fail-on high`: CI gates
- `cortex compile "<task>"` then `cortex verify --contract <file>`: check an agent's change against its task
- `cortex ui`: read-only local portal at http://localhost:7777
